title: CG4AI: A Column Generation Framework for Training AI Models Under Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.26375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard machine-learning training minimizes a loss function over a dataset, but does not guarantee that the resulting model will satisfy predefined rules or constraints on its outputs. In many real-world applications, ranging from autonomous systems to network routing, such guarantees are essential. We propose CG4AI, a framework that builds a convex combination of AI models while enforcing linear constraints on the combined output. A master linear program (LP) determines the optimal mixture weights, while a pricing subproblem generates new models guided by LP dual variables, focusing attention on the most violated constraints. A cutting-plane procedure extends feasibility guarantees beyond the training set. translated_title: CG4AI：一种在约束条件下训练AI模型的列生成框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26375v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：标准机器学习训练在数据集上最小化损失函数，但不保证生成的模型会满足预定义规则或对其输出的约束。在许多实际应用中，从自动驾驶系统到网络路由，这种保证至关重要。我们提出CG4AI，一个构建AI模型凸组合并在组合输出上强制线性约束的框架。主线性规划（LP）确定最优混合权重，而定价子问题在LP对偶变量的引导下生成新模型，重点关注最违反的约束。切割平面过程将可行性保证扩展到训练集之外。我们将CG4AI应用于两个问题：（i）MNIST上的数字分类，展示了约束的四种不同用途，仅从约束中学习、提高对抗鲁棒性、纠正误分类示例，以及确保输出一致性。
tldr: CG4AI通过列生成框架构建AI模型凸组合，在线性约束下优化混合权重，实现训练后模型的约束保证，并扩展到训练集外的可行性。
en_tdlr: CG4AI uses a column generation framework to build convex combinations of AI models, optimizing mixture weights under linear constraints, ensuring post-training constraint satisfaction and extending feasibility beyond the training set.
